content.name: gitex
content.description: Git-backed line comments and collaboration for LaTeX papers.

commands.title: GiTex: Apply Repository to Current Folder

viewsWelcome.contents:
Open a paper file to show comments for its Git repository. Repositories in subfolders are discovered automatically.
Select lines and run [Add Line Comment](command:gitex.addComment).
[Clone Repository](command:gitex.clone) · [Apply to Current Folder](command:gitex.applyRepository) · [Connect Repository](command:gitex.connect)
Comments sync automatically after saving by default.

gitex.autoPullOnInteraction.description: Legacy preference retained for compatibility. Interactions no longer fetch comments.
gitex.autoPullOnInteraction.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `#gitex.autoSyncOnSave#`. If that setting is unset, a previous false value keeps automatic synchronization disabled.

gitex.remote.description: Git remote used by Sync Comments. The remote branch gitex-comments is reserved for GiTex.

gitex.showResolved.description: Legacy setting. Resolved threads always remain in GiTex Comments and are hidden from the paper editor.
gitex.showResolved.deprecationMessage: Resolved threads are now always listed in Explorer. Use their checkbox to resolve or reopen them.

gitex.autoSyncOnSave.description: Fetch and push comments once in the background after creating a comment, replying, or saving an edit or manual location move. Opening, clicking, expanding, or canceling comments does not access the remote.
